# Redeem Requirements Checklist: Redeem Code (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 015 — secrecy of the code, idempotent and online-only sending, correctness of "which plan now applies", refusal coverage, P-12 billing-surface limits, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): privacy of the code first, then the governing-plan message and refusal coverage, then contract fidelity and UX completeness; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, research or contracts in the same session; each says where. `[x]` = reviewed and holds (or fixed); unchecked items are left for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified what happens to a success that arrives after the person left the screen? [Gap → fixed: FR-012 "Leaving the screen … MUST NOT stop a success from being applied", Edge Cases "Leaving during a request", research R-06, redeem-domain rule 2]
- [x] CHK002 Is the confirmation defined when the governing subscription is in its grace period? [Gap → fixed: FR-013 "named with its grace end date", research R-07, data-model §2]
- [x] CHK003 Is Back on the confirmation defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-016 "Done and Back"]
- [x] CHK004 Is the keyboard's done action defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 Is the initial focus of the field defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-002]
- [x] CHK006 Is the general failure defined when the answer carries no request id? [Gap → fixed: FR-026, research R-08 `error_generic`]
- [x] CHK007 Is every code the backend lists for `POST /billing/redeem` either mapped to an outcome or explicitly generic? [Completeness, FR-017–FR-026, contracts/redeem-api-client.md]
- [x] CHK008 Is the claim endpoint explicitly excluded, with a test? [Completeness, Spec §5 "Not used, ever", redeem-api-client.md]
- [x] CHK009 Are the E2E ways to reach each refusal (used, expired, other address, unverified, unknown, offline) specified, including how the code is obtained? [Completeness, research R-12, contracts/ui-and-e2e.md]
